name: Reset controller
notes: Second payload byte is 15 for hardware letters I/J/K/U/V/W, otherwise 5; first byte 136. Preserve the conditional; nearby-assignment index hints alone are insufficient. This row maps a reviewed action, not every UI control.

notes: GraphPage case Y label explicitly requests non-following status. Do not infer a generic angle-test meaning from the enclosing handler name. This row maps a reviewed action, not every UI control.

notes: Query request; completion must be observed separately. This row maps a reviewed action, not every UI control.

name: Export controller parameters as HEB
notes: Requires the official new-data completion condition; packs main and extended words. Hidden repeated-cancel path starts a separate legacy diagnostic read and is not ordinary export.

name: Import parameter file to controller
notes: ConnectPage.cs:5967-6003 checks binding/new-version and sets CopyNewData/NewCnt after confirmation. This is a device write flow, unlike the web app JSON import.

name: Prepare hardware-specific GDriver HEB restore
notes: Hardware G selects a distinct CRC seed, compact subtype, and configuration-frame inclusion. Semantic record remains medium because some helper bodies are absent from the unsupported Hermes decompile.

name: Select native polling pages
notes: Returns 13 poll pages and 27 config pages; lists are logical addresses, not RX index bytes.
